nodes.label: UV DM water header across page
nodes.description: UV DM water enters through connector 3995 and line UDW-25-B1H-n-1310050. The utility header continues left-to-right to off-page connector 4011.

nodes.label: Instrument-air header for storage-tank inlet valves
nodes.description: Instrument air enters at connector 3997 and is distributed through IA-25-C1A-n-1316050 to the storage-tank temperature valve functions. The header continues across the page through the instrument-air header and off-page connectors 4004 and 12091.

nodes.label: Polymer header PG-100-B1X-n-1228023 and controlled tank branches
nodes.description: Polymer enters through connector 3999 and line PG-100-B1X-n-1228023. The TV-1257002 and TV-1257008 valve functions and associated interlocks control storage-tank filling branches, while the storage-tank header continues to connector 4010.

nodes.label: Polymer header PG-100-B1X-n-1228022 and controlled tank branches
nodes.description: Polymer enters at connector 4009 and flows through PG-100-B1X-n-1228022. TV-1257003 and TV-1257006 control branches toward ST-V303 and ST-V305, with the remaining header continuing to connector 4002.

nodes.label: Polymer header PG-100-B1X-n-1228021 and controlled tank branches
nodes.description: Polymer enters at connector 4001 and flows through PG-100-B1X-n-1228021. TV-1257004 and TV-1257007 provide controlled branches toward the storage tanks while the main header continues to connector 4008.

nodes.label: Controlled receipts and storage in ST-V305
nodes.description: Controlled polymer branches enter ST-V305 through lines P-100-B1H-n-1257009 and P-100-B1H-n-1257010 and the XV1-1257029 inlet arrangement. ST-V305 stores the polymer, with level, position, and weighing instrumentation monitoring inventory and valve status.

nodes.label: Instrument-air supply to filter packages and actuated valves
nodes.description: Instrument air enters through the V3-P.01-1316-A0 off-page connection and IA-15-C1A-n-1316039. Local branches IA-15-C1A-n-1257085 and IA-15-C1A-n-1257086 pass through filter-regulators AFR-1257001, I027, and I026 to the filter-package pneumatic users.

nodes.label: P-V305A/B discharge routing to polymer distribution manifold
nodes.description: Discharges from P-V305A and P-V305B pass through XV1-1257016 and XV1-1257015 into the P-100-B1H-n-1257027 distribution manifold. Manual branch valves route polymer to the MIX-V103 through MIX-V137 destinations, with additional continuations to R5803 and tanker-loading interfaces.

nodes.label: Reactor R5803 receipts and storage in ST-V303
nodes.description: R5803 receipts arrive from the REA-V211 through REA-V217 off-page interfaces and the associated tank inlet lines and isolation devices. ST-V303 stores the material, with level, position, and weighing instrumentation monitoring inventory and inlet status.

nodes.label: ST-V303 agitation
nodes.description: Top-entry agitator STA-V303 mixes the contents of storage tank ST-V303. This is a self-contained mechanical duty with no separate material flow path.

nodes.label: ST-V303 low-point and backwash drain routing
nodes.description: Low-point outlets from ST-V303 are routed through normally closed isolation valves and the BW-1257013 line. The branches form the tank drain or backwash withdrawal function and terminate at the downstream piping boundaries shown on this page.

nodes.label: ST-V305 agitation
nodes.description: Top-entry agitator STA-V305 mixes the contents of storage tank ST-V305. This is a self-contained mechanical duty without a distinct material inlet or outlet.

nodes.label: P-V305A overpressure relief
nodes.description: The P-V305A discharge system is protected by PSV-1257001. Overpressure is relieved from P-100-B1H-n-1257022 through P-50-B1H-n-1257023 to the downstream relief destination.

nodes.label: ST-V305 transfer through F-V305A and P-V305A
nodes.description: Polymer is routed through the A-side feed to self-cleaning filter F-V305A, then through the pump suction piping to transfer pump P-V305A. Temperature, differential-pressure, and discharge-pressure instrumentation monitor the train before discharge through P-100-B1H-n-1257022.

nodes.label: F-V305A backwash collection in VES-V305A
nodes.description: Backwash and package drainage from F-V305A are isolated by XV1-1257019 and XV1-1257047 and routed through BW-1257014 and P-100-B1H-n-1257050. VES-V305A collects the discharge, with ZS-1257032 and associated interlocks monitoring valve or vessel status.

nodes.label: Tanker unloading with inhibitor addition
nodes.description: Tanker product enters through the unloading connection and flexible hose, passes through the check and manual isolation valves, and joins line P-100. Inhibitor can be manually added from STPOT-NS302 through its isolated and check-valved branch before the combined flow proceeds through P-150-B1H-n-1257084.

nodes.label: Sump SU-V301 collection and discharge
nodes.description: Spillage, effluent, and rain water collect in sump SU-V301. Level switch and alarm LS-1257024 and LA-1257024 monitor the sump, while isolated effluent and rain-water lines leave through off-page connectors 4898 and 4862.

nodes.label: ST-V303 transfer through F-V303A and P-V303A
nodes.description: Polymer from the ST-V303-side suction system is routed through F-V303A and then to positive-displacement pump P-V303A. Filter differential pressure, temperature, and pump discharge pressure are monitored before the flow leaves through P-100-B1H-n-1257042.

nodes.label: ST-V305 transfer through F-V305B and P-V305B
nodes.description: The B-side transfer train routes polymer through F-V305B and line P-100-B1H-n-1257087 to positive-displacement pump P-V305B. Differential-pressure, temperature, and pump-discharge pressure instruments monitor the train before discharge through P-100-B1H-n-1257018.

nodes.label: P-V303A/B discharge selection and routing
nodes.description: P-V303A and P-V303B discharges are selected through XV1-1257013 and XV1-1257014 and routed through the P-100 discharge lines. Associated interlocks coordinate the two discharge valves, with additional isolation at the downstream continuation.

nodes.label: P-V305B overpressure relief
nodes.description: The P-V305B discharge system is protected by PSV-1257002. Relief is taken from the P-V305B-side process piping and discharged through P-50-B1H-n-1257019 toward the downstream relief destination.

nodes.label: F-V305B backwash collection in VES-V305B
nodes.description: Drain or backwash material from F-V305B is collected in VES-V305B. ZS-1257045 and its interlock references provide collection-vessel or isolation-status monitoring.

nodes.label: P-V303A overpressure relief
nodes.description: The P-V303A discharge system is protected by PSV-1257003. The valve relieves from the pump-side line P-80-B1H-n-1257041 toward the downstream relief destination.

nodes.label: F-V303A backwash collection in VES-V303A
nodes.description: F-V303A drain or backwash material is isolated by XV1-1257020 and collected in VES-V303A. ZS-1257033 indicates collection-vessel or associated valve status.

nodes.label: P-V303B overpressure relief
nodes.description: The P-V303B discharge system is protected by PSV-1257004. The valve relieves from line P-80-B1H-n-1257045 toward the downstream relief destination.

nodes.label: ST-V303 transfer through F-V303B and P-V303B
nodes.description: The B-side train routes polymer through F-V303B and onward to positive-displacement pump P-V303B. Filter differential pressure, temperature, and discharge pressure are monitored before flow exits through P-100-B1H-n-1257046.

nodes.label: F-V303B backwash collection in VES-V303B
nodes.description: Drain or backwash material from F-V303B is collected in VES-V303B through the package isolation arrangement. ZS-1257046 monitors the collection vessel or associated valve position.
